lines.trans: Mr Chun Yuqiao, what is packed inside your parcel that makes it so heavy? Let me open it for you.
Hold on, is your hand alright? Come here, hold out your hands.
My hands are fine; you are overthinking it.
Paper books get dirty easily, so go wash your hands first.
Mr Chun Yuqiao, why are they all copies of the same classic? Is this a special hobby of yours?
Laozi wrote this classic over two thousand years ago, and scholars ever since have written different commentaries.
Across every era, every edition, and every publisher, the commentaries all differ.
If you are going to read it, read carefully; the commentary on this single line runs three pages.
Have you spotted anything in it?
I spotted it — those commentators overthought everything!
Read these three characters aloud; even read backwards, they still make sense.
